paragraphs: DeepWalk sells automated sidewalk inspection software that uses iPhone LiDAR to identify condition and access issues. Work is planned, inspected, analyzed and implemented on one platform. Projects range from small residential work to city-wide deployments.

Crews scan sidewalk and curb ramps with the LiDAR scanners in iPhone Pros through the mobile app. An automated measurement system then inspects the scans for condition and accessibility issues. Data comes back in the web app and in ArcGIS. There, inspections are managed, conditions reviewed and work orders created for improvements. A higher plan is aimed at large evaluations and long-term planning projects that require slope analysis.

All plans include the full capability of the mobile app, which is downloaded from the Apple App Store. The site describes a pilot in which Edina, MN, got faster, more efficient data collection. Another story says Genoa, IL, went from data collection to program implementation and earned statewide recognition.

quote.text: Plan, inspect, analyze, and implement sidewalk projects all on one platform.
